evals.prompt: I want Julie to find a cursed sword connected to Diego's war. Help me figure out how to weave that in naturally over the next couple sessions.
evals.expected_output: Research Julie's character, Diego lore, current party trajectory, and existing vault content. Surface connections, then offer 3-5 short sparks (1-3 sentences each). Ask the DM to pick.

assertions.text: Read Julie's player/character file
Searched for Diego references in the vault
Checked current party location and trajectory
Presented vault connections as a short list before sparks
Offered 3-5 sparks, each 1-3 sentences max
Sparks connect to existing vault content, not pure invention
Checked active narratives for conflicts
Did NOT create files — presented sparks only
Asked DM to pick a direction

evals.prompt: I want to set up a betrayal — someone the party trusts turns on them. Plant seeds over a few sessions. How could I do that?
evals.expected_output: Research trusted NPCs, existing relationships, faction tensions. Surface which NPCs have secret motivations that could lead to betrayal. Offer sparks for how to seed it gradually.

assertions.text: Researched NPCs the party trusts or has allied with
Identified NPCs with existing secrets or hidden motivations
Used beat vocabulary (seed, echo, hook) for pacing
Offered 3-5 sparks focused on gradual betrayal setup
Sparks are 1-3 sentences, not full scripts
Did NOT create files
Asked DM to pick or combine

evals.prompt: I want Salty Pete to become a more important NPC. Right now he's just a boat race guy. How do I make the party care about him?
evals.expected_output: Research Salty Pete's file, connections, the boat race, his crew. Surface what's already there that could deepen his role. Offer sparks for making him matter.

assertions.text: Read Salty Pete's NPC files (private and/or public)
Searched for Salty Pete mentions in session journals
Surfaced existing connections (crew, boat race, Merchants Guild)
Offered 3-5 sparks for deepening Salty Pete's role
Sparks are short (1-3 sentences each)
Did NOT create files
Asked DM to pick a direction
